svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 8 (CUMULATIVE R488) · JAVA SPEC ANNOTATIONS, VISUAL BOARD & OFFLINE ZIM MCP
speclok (@Spec/@AC Java Gate) + archinario-agent + dataforseo-agent ($1 Cap) + zim-mcp (Rust Kiwix)
1. Cherobin/speclok (★12 · 5 forks · Java 11+ JDK-Only · MIT)
• Compiler-Enforced @Spec & @AC Annotations in Java Source
javac fails compilation on incomplete specs (error: spec-lint [T-200]: objective is empty)
MCP + hooks enforce allowedFiles & outOfScope so agents never drift across legacy code
2. archinario/archinario-agent (★15 · Go CLI + MCP · MIT)
• Connects local coding agents to the interactive Archinario architecture board
• Co-design services, PostgreSQL, message brokers & K8s with animated traffic flows
• Combine agent generation with manual drag-and-drop & 1-click batch undo
• Zero hosted LLM lock-in; runs entirely through your local agent client
3. AgriciDaniel/dataforseo-agent (★20 · 576 Endpoints · MIT)
• Price-First Routing, Double Confirmation & $1.00 Session Cap
Picks cheapest valid DataForSEO v3 endpoint (SERP, Geogrid, Backlinks, AI Visibility)
Shows catalog price twice before spending; renders 16 terminal chart/map views
4. gordonbrander/zim-mcp (★25 · Pure Rust · GPL-3.0)
• Pure-Rust port of Kiwix libzim (zimfile) + Xapian index reader (zimfile-xapian)
• Searches offline Wikipedia, Stack Overflow & docs over MCP stdio with 0 build step
• Resumable SHA-256 verified downloads & atomic <name>_<YYYY-MM>.zim updates
• Single self-contained binary with zero C++ system library dependencies
💰 CLOSED-FORM FINOPS BENCHMARK (CLAIM-20261118-R8-SPECLOK-ARCHINARIO-DATAFORSEO-ZIM · 50 SEATS)
